birth.conversion_note: Birth date 12/13 July; year 100 BCE per traditional dating

death.conversion_note: Assassinated in the Theatre of Pompey, Rome

short_description_en: Roman general, statesman, and dictator. Conqueror of Gaul (58-50 BCE), victor in the Civil War against Pompey (49-45 BCE), and dictator perpetuo until his assassination in 44 BCE. Author of Commentarii de Bello Gallico and de Bello Civili. His name became the imperial title 'Caesar'.
short_description_zh: 罗马将军、政治家和独裁官。征服高卢（前58-50年），内战中击败庞培（前49-45年），任终身独裁官至前44年被刺杀。著有《高卢战记》和《内战记》。其名号成为后世罗马皇帝头衔。
